fields.FIR_Description: During the afternoon of 2026-06-19, around 14:15, the complainant received calls demanding Rs. 25,000 with warnings of consequences if the amount was not paid, according to the complaint recorded on 2026-06-19. Chithra Raj reported the matter orally at Coimbatore North PS; the contact number given was 9000000303. Siva Sekar (9000000284) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Madhan Palanisamy, using the number 9000000295. The complaint refers to Naveen Muthu, a business acquaintance, reachable on 9000000375. The complainant mentioned mobile phone records.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Caller allegedly demanded money with threats of consequences.
fields.Keywords: extortion, money demand, suspect, witness, associate, afternoon, mobile number, residential colony
